Messages.Author: Marc Erl
Messages.Body:
Hi,
Hmm, After reading some articles about Fame I had a look at it and saw
that in the VtES edition it is unique (it is not in Jyhad). Is this on
the errata-list (why should there be only one famous Vampire???)?
I ask this because an opponent drove me crazy with his Sethites
Fame/Mummify combos and I would be glad if I was able to contest his
fame. However, IF it is unique, who pays the contesting costs? Is it a
kind of title (minion pays) or a simple master (pool loss)?
Marc

Messages.Author: Joe Helfrich
Messages.Body:
Marc Erl (er...@uni-muenster.de) wrote:
: Hi,

Hoi chummer.

: Hmm, After reading some articles about Fame I had a look at it and saw

: that in the VtES edition it is unique (it is not in Jyhad). Is this on
: the errata-list (why should there be only one famous Vampire???)?

Yep, it's official eratta back to Jyhad versions. And I look at it as
being not that there's only one famous vampire, but that there's only one
_REALLY_ famous vampire, since the Camarilla will only let the masquerade
be bent so far. :)

: I ask this because an opponent drove me crazy with his Sethites

Settites.

: Fame/Mummify combos and I would be glad if I was able to contest his

: fame. However, IF it is unique, who pays the contesting costs? Is it a
: kind of title (minion pays) or a simple master (pool loss)?

It being a bonus to the individual vampire, the vampires pay it.

Joe

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
j...@dimensional.com (Joe Helfrich) writes:

>Marc Erl (er...@uni-muenster.de) wrote:
>: Hmm, After reading some articles about Fame I had a look at it and saw
>: that in the VtES edition it is unique (it is not in Jyhad). Is this on
>: the errata-list (why should there be only one famous Vampire???)?

>: Fame/Mummify combos and I would be glad if I was able to contest his
>: fame. However, IF it is unique, who pays the contesting costs? Is it a
>: kind of title (minion pays) or a simple master (pool loss)?

>It being a bonus to the individual vampire, the vampires pay it.

It being a card (not a title), the Methuselah pays it. Vampires
only pay to contest titles. There is a house rule in some
places to treat Fame as if it were a title, but that isn't official.
